description:
Run a backtest for the 'SampleMACrossover' strategy on 'SPY' (Daily data) from Jan 2023 to Dec 2024 using the Strategy Analyzer. 

After running the backtest, you must:
1. Switch the results grid view from the default 'Summary' to 'Annual' periods (showing a breakdown by year).
2. Export this Annual grid to a CSV file named 'annual_report.csv' in the Documents folder ('C:\Users\Docker\Documents\').

The exported file must clearly show rows for individual years (2023 and 2024).
